maker-api.label: The maker's own API
maker-api.note: One route for every maker's own API (the build and models.json name it `maker-api`: names with route null, conversions, base prices); its defaults and conversions are the models.json ones. Folded at the merge of 23 Oct 2026 from the part's per-maker routes, kept here for the record: anthropic-api (Anthropic API, operator anthropic: spellings ['Anthropic', 'anthropic', 'Anthropic API', 'anthropic-api', 'anthropic-first-party', 'served-by:anthropic'], prefixes ['anthropic/']); openai-api (OpenAI API, operator openai: spellings ['OpenAI', 'openai', 'OpenAI API', 'OpenAI direct', 'openai-api', 'openai_responses', 'openai/flex', 'served-by:openai', 'served-by:OpenAI'], prefixes ['openai/']); google-ai (Google AI (Gemini API / AI Studio), operator google: spellings ['Google', 'google', 'google_genai', 'gemini', 'gemini-flex', 'Google AI Studio', 'google-ai-studio', 'google-ai-api-direct', 'served-by:google', 'served-by:Google'], prefixes ['google/', 'gemini/']); xai-api (xAI API, operator xai: spellings ['xAI', 'xai', 'grok', 'xai/zdr', 'xai-zdr', 'served-by:xai', 'served-by:xAI'], prefixes ['xai/']); deepseek-api (DeepSeek API, operator deepseek: spellings ['DeepSeek', 'deepseek', 'deepseek-api', 'DeepSeek-AI API', 'deepseek-official-api', 'served-by:deepseek'], prefixes ['deepseek/']); alibaba-api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope / Bailian), operator alibaba: spellings ['Alibaba', 'alibaba', 'alibaba-cloud(hosted)', 'Alibaba Cloud International', 'bailian', 'bailian-compatible', 'dashscope', 'served-by:Alibaba'], prefixes ['alibaba/', 'dashscope/', 'bailian/']); zai-api (Z.ai / Zhipu BigModel API, operator zhipu: spellings ['Z.AI', 'Z.ai', 'z.ai', 'zai', 'zhipu-bigmodel', 'glm', 'Z.ai direct API', 'served-by:zai', 'served-by:Z.AI'], prefixes ['z-ai/', 'zai/', 'zhipu/']); moonshot-api (Moonshot (Kimi) API, operator moonshot: spellings ['Moonshot', 'moonshot', 'Moonshot native API', 'moonshotai'], prefixes ['moonshot/', 'moonshotai/']); mistral-api (Mistral API, operator other: spellings ['Mistral', 'Mistral API', 'mistral api(as printed)', 'mistral'], prefixes ['mistral/']). Spellings added 26 Oct (gaps-configdates): anthropic-opus5 (obviousbench: upstream Anthropic transport), kimi (platform.kimi.ai, Moonshot), meta (Inspect meta provider: Meta Model API), perplexity (Inspect perplexity provider), longcat (api.longcat.chat, Meituan), celeris (inference.celeris.ai, celeris-1), aion (api.aionlabs.ai, AionLabs), tinker and tinker-native (Thinking Machines, upstream thinkingmachines). The spelling openai-api (already in the merged routes) is withdrawn 26 Oct: Inspect openai-api is a generic OpenAI-compatible provider (obviousbench serves xAI and LM Studio through it), not the maker API.
